notes.title: Updated Limited Demo 1.1 for SEAGO
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43319597/29dbe7d4111b7246dabfb1030a75e2162f967329.png[/img]
We are participating in SEAGO, with it we updated limited demo will be accessible until the end of[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/25278687-Virtual-SEA-Games-from-SEAsia/sale/seago2023] SEAGO[/url] in January 8th,
give it a try to the Demo before SEAGO ended, and please sent us your feedback it is very helpful to us.
[h1]Change log:[/h1]
Based on several feedback we acquired, we have made several changes to the demo and the game overall, our changes are as follow;
--> Fixed where in some case a character/enemy will get seemingly unlimited turns
--> Simplifies more icon-oriented skill descriptions
--> Changing several icon to better represent what it actually means
--> Replaces and balances some other skills
--> Fixed bugs on row formations
--> Added credits on the ending
--> Decorated the dungeon even more
--> Added the triangle of advantage Hud
--> Adjusted the battle Hud colours and positioning
--> Changed Shuilong sprite to suit in game battler
--> Small optimizations
--> Can now escape normal battles
--> Added several animations

notes.title: Qisah Tomang: Cycle Ends DEMO is out now!
notes.content:
[b]Qisah Tomang: Cycle Ends Public Demo is out now![/b]

Go with Zemi, B.W., Aiq, Ani, Shaoke, and Ina and explore the Sleeping Dragon's lair.


Try it out, tell us your experience and please send us any feedback via discussion or Email.

You may have noticed we have newer logo now, that is easier to read and fit the theme of the game.

notes.title: Qisah Tomang Trailer Released
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=V6ODodszLuA;full][/previewyoutube]

We are excited to announce the release of the trailer for our upcoming game, Qisah Tomang: Cycle Ends. Our team has been hard at work crafting a thrilling adventure. The trailer gives a glimpse of the epic journey that awaits you, with stunning visuals, engaging characters, and an immersive storyline.

We are excited to share that Qisah Tomang: Cycle Ends has now completed the closed-alpha testing phase. we are committed to addressing your concerns and improving the game based on your feedback.

Qisah Tomang: Cycle Ends will be available soon on Steam, so stay tuned for more updates and information. We look forward to sharing this epic adventure with you!

notes.title: Qisah Tomang is now available to wishlist!
notes.content:
We are here to announce that we are working on a new game called Qisah Tomang : Cycle Ends.

Synopsis:
The peace of the world has been broken by the awakening of an Ancient Demon. The world, divided and weakened, is unprepared to fight it. However, Three adventurers rise up to challenge the Demon. Follow their story and choose their path in their adventure. 

Get notified when the game is released by wishlisting on Steam!
